asset.calibrationSource: Committed 3244ab1 src/presentation/ImportedWeaponView.ts prepareWeapon; no uncommitted implementation copied

api.callLocation: Owner's world/NPC gun construction after makeCarbine or makeSidearm returns. Pass only that gun root; never an actor root or first-person arms root.
api.disposeIntegration: registerModelDisposer on the gun root calls attachment.dispose before disposeModelTree traverses GPU resources. It detaches imported clone, restores original muzzle/fallback, and releases the source lease.
api.defaultPath: import.meta.env.BASE_URL + models/weapons/ak47-world-r1.glb, resolved against location.href when available

calibration.scaleNote: Only source-to-0.89 local calibration is applied. The existing outer 0.68 remains and is not applied a second time. Owner should judge final size with character proportions; if 0.89 is intended as final world length, adjust that outer convention deliberately.
calibration.muzzle: Original muzzle node object is reparented to MuzzleDeviceTip with identity local transform. A sidearm placeholder without one gets an owned muzzle marker. Dispose restores/removes it appropriately.

lifecycle.sharing: One default module-owned reference-counted pool, keyed by resolved local runtime URL. Concurrent NPCs share one download/template, geometries/materials/textures; each clone has independent transform nodes.
lifecycle.fallback: Captured original gun meshes remain visible during loading and after failure; only those meshes hide after complete calibration and attachment.
lifecycle.retry: No automatic retry. Repeated attach on the same live parent returns its existing handle. Explicit dispose followed by attach may start a new request.
lifecycle.cancellation: Removing one pending consumer preserves siblings. Removing the last consumer aborts download; a decoder that finishes late is released without attaching.
lifecycle.resourceRelease: Borrowed clones are detached before procedural tree disposal; template GPU resources are freed once after the last reference.
lifecycle.firstPerson: Independent of the first-person ModelLibrary. NPCs deduplicate with one another; world and first-person caches are currently separate.

remaining: Root must wire allied/enemy/opponent world gun factories; this module alone does not replace any actor yet.
Root owns runtime GLB/license copy and main/characters integration.
Actual PBR rendering, hand contact, weapon size and scene performance need in-game review.
No AI, firing, damage, collision or navigation rules changed. Moving the visual muzzle marker does not itself change simulation ballistics origins.
No world gun recoil/reload animation or LOD is added. Each visible gun currently costs 10 meshes / 23644 triangles; geometry/material reuse does not reduce its draw calls.
Default loader checks pinned size, GLB header, self-contained resources and node geometry contract; SHA identity is verified by the test/artifact, not recomputed for every browser load.
